result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my top recommendation would be **Xero**\. It's particularly good for small businesses that want to manage invoices, expenses, bank transactions, GST and BAS without spending hours on bookkeeping.

However, the best choice depends on the type of business, how many transactions you process and whether you do your own bookkeeping.

## My top 4 accounting software choices

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Easy to learn and use.
- Automatic bank feeds and reconciliation.
- Invoicing, expenses, GST and BAS.
- Integrates with many other business apps.
- Good collaboration with accountants.

Indicative pricing: from \$37/month.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and inventory)

- Excellent Australian business compliance features.
- Strong payroll functionality.
- Good for businesses holding stock.
- Useful reporting and accounting tools.

Indicative pricing: from \$35/month for Business Lite.

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Quickbooks Online — Columbus Business Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/z_-lMr1rk7nVCnHpykvHbFlLn1azsDdLq1E5IPLLHaY_8oSNYyauUS0LtpVtMtsr7aGmH36ThTapoKB2Ph5Q3eMVc_UXwvW966z4ZTJF_6xHgqWw4BiwFU5MO1xbGE5oY_mXKemXduz1fPiAwGEyT1jt_IjAl-f9situ1bcy769twmRe-HD-uB1wI8CWqiLV?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Straightforward invoicing and expense tracking.
- Good financial reporting.
- Useful for smaller service-based businesses.
- Worth considering if you want simple bookkeeping.

Indicative pricing: from \$33/month.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon One**

- Good budget-friendly option.
- GST and BAS tracking.
- Invoicing and bank reconciliation.
- Optional payroll modules.

Indicative pricing: from \$24/month.

[Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

Prices are indicative Australian list prices, not guaranteed quotes. Check current plan limits and introductory offers before subscribing. ## Which one would I recommend?

For most small Australian businesses, I'd start with Xero. But I'd like to narrow it down before recommending a particular subscription.
